div.style: color: rgb(19, 33, 60) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
1 · INPUT CONTRACT
User intent + AliCCP data
Organizer splits, metrics, baseline,
evaluator, schema, ε, N, budgets

div.style: color: rgb(59, 42, 10) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
2 · RESEARCH INTEGRITY KERNEL
Authority resolution + policy gate
Split-taint firewall + capability broker
Hashes, budgets, retries, token/GPU clock

div.style: color: rgb(59, 42, 10) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
3 · OFFICIAL BASELINE GATE
Pinned environment and seeds
Data/schema/leakage validation
Smoke → full NISE baseline
No research until reproduced

div.style: color: rgb(16, 59, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
4 · DETERMINISTIC DIAGNOSTICS
EDA, imbalance, cardinality, shift
Unseen IDs, curves, runtime, memory
Leakage-safe transform artifacts

div.style: color: rgb(40, 19, 77) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
5 · RESEARCH AGENT
Retrieve scoped prior evidence
Choose one causal hypothesis
Pre-register outcomes and falsifiers
Budgeted experiment contract

div.style: color: rgb(40, 19, 77) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
6 · CODE/RECOVERY AGENT + RUNNER
Isolated minimal code patch
Policy/unit/schema/leakage/smoke tests
Train on TRAIN only
Official evaluator on VALIDATION

div.style: color: rgb(73, 37, 7) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
7 · OUTCOME CONTROLLER
Valid and reproducible?
Improves parent/baseline > ε?
Noise, task trade-off, over/underfit?
Retry, reject, branch, retain, or stop

div.style: color: rgb(16, 59, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
8 · ONE-WAY FINALIZER
Freeze validation-best artifact
Clean replay + submission-schema check
Generate predictions from TEST FEATURES
Organizer hidden evaluation once
Render judge package and demo

div.style: color: rgb(16, 59, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
READ-ONLY EVIDENCE GATEWAY
Curated papers + allowlisted repositories
Pinned commits, licenses, provenance
Cached; called only for novel questions

div.style: color: rgb(75, 16, 16) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
TEST LABEL VAULT
locked from all development components

div.style: color: rgb(23, 32, 51) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
APPEND-ONLY EVENT + LINEAGE BUS
Every plan, action, metric, retry, decision,
resource unit, and intervention is recorded

div.style: color: rgb(23, 32, 51) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
RUN LEDGER
SQLite locally / PostgreSQL for concurrency
required YAML/JSON fields + frontier

div.style: color: rgb(23, 32, 51) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
ARTIFACT STORE
local NVMe cache + optional S3/MinIO
data, checkpoints, predictions, plots, logs

span.p:
CODE PROVENANCE
Git commit + immutable diff + config hash

claim + context + provenance + confidence
supports / contradicts / supersedes
